text: A股零售股反复活跃，上海九百冲击涨停，大东方此前封板，国芳集团、大连友谊涨超5%，百大集团、天虹股份涨幅居前。
text_en: A-share retail stocks were repeatedly active. Shanghai Jiu Bai hit the daily limit, Da Dong Fang had previously sealed the limit, Guo Fang Group and Dalian Friendship rose more than 5%, and Bai Da Group and Tianhong shares were among the top gainers.
